name: DF_REVIEW_DECISION
description: Reviewer decision – Approve / Return / Query / Forward / Reject
javascript: $('#reviewDecision').setOnchange(function(v){ if(v=='RETURN' || v=='QUERY' || v=='REJECT'){ $('#reviewRemarks').setRequired(true); } else { $('#reviewRemarks').setRequired(false); } if(v=='FORWARD'){ $('#forwardTo').setRequired(true); } else { $('#forwardTo').setRequired(false); } });
